phase: Phase 11: Robust AutoML Benchmarking & Statistical Reliability

profiler_instrumentation.process_rss_scope: psutil.Process().memory_info().rss (Resident Set Size including native C libs)
profiler_instrumentation.sampling_overhead: Low: Monotonic timing via time.perf_counter(), instantaneous pre/post fit memory reads

scientific_safeguards.leakage_prevention: Train/Val and Holdout Test partition strictly isolated at 80/20. Feature scaling and imputation transformers fit strictly inside each CV fold. Final holdout test set evaluated post-selection and never used for model selection or tuning.

statistical_methods.sample_variance: Bessel's correction (ddof=1) applied for all sample standard deviations
statistical_methods.confidence_intervals: Student's t-distribution with df=N-1 and Non-Parametric Bootstrap (B=1000 resamples)
statistical_methods.paired_comparison: Exact per-seed difference Delta_s = Score_A,s - Score_B,s on matched partitions
statistical_methods.multiple_testing: Bonferroni FWER adjustment: p_adj = min(1.0, p * m)
statistical_methods.small_sample_policy: Conservative warning for N < 5; non-rejection of null does not prove equivalence

dataset.name: Wine Recognition Benchmark
dataset.provenance: Forina et al. (1991), Institute of Pharmaceutical and Food Analysis and Technologies, Genoa / OpenML ID 187
dataset.description: 178 instances, 13 continuous chemical constituents of wines grown in the same region in Italy across 3 cultivars.

validation_score.interpretation_notes: Sample statistics based on N=5 independent seed replicates. Sample standard deviation computed with Bessel's correction (ddof=1). Confidence intervals characterize sampling variability of the mean across seeds. Note: Overlapping confidence intervals between competing models do not prove equivalence; cross-validation fold evaluations within an individual seed are not independent replicates.

paired_comparisons.interpretation: 'logistic_regression' demonstrates statistically significant superiority over 'decision_tree' on f1_weighted (mean paired delta = +0.0824, p = 0.0006 < 0.05, Cohen's dz = 5.99 [large] across N=5 matched seeds).

'random_forest' demonstrates statistically significant superiority over 'decision_tree' on f1_weighted (mean paired delta = +0.0584, p = 0.0120 < 0.05, Cohen's dz = 2.66 [large] across N=5 matched seeds).

'hist_gradient_boosting' demonstrates statistically significant superiority over 'decision_tree' on f1_weighted (mean paired delta = +0.0543, p = 0.0276 < 0.05, Cohen's dz = 2.11 [large] across N=5 matched seeds).
